contract: design-contract.md: admin queue and deliberate publishing decisions in the existing OpenRaise visual system; inspect story/media before acting, with private admin permissions and recoverable stale state.

accessibility.evidence: Styled desktop queue and mobile rejection form: axe WCAG2 A/AA and WCAG2.1 AA report zero violations; explicit labels, acknowledgement, feedback and keyboard controls.

responsive.evidence: Queue and detail have no document overflow at 390px; computed desktop row display is grid and review header is flex. Mobile rows stack and decision controls fit.

loading.evidence: A delayed decision POST shows Recording decision… with disabled controls until its response.

empty.evidence: Unmatched search shows No matching campaigns and a clear-search link.

error.evidence: Fixture API 503 renders retry state; stale 409 retains reason and offers reload.

partial.evidence: Failed photo request triggers the existing gallery fallback while story and decision remain readable.

success.evidence: Fixture approve and return update campaign state and show review history after refresh.

permission.evidence: Non-admin sees Administrator access needed; signed-out admin URL redirects to signin. Real API tests assert role checks and unpublished privacy.

renderedEvidence.observation: Oldest-first queue with search, state filters, pending count, restrained row layout and campaign thumbnails.
Media/story column and separate decision sidebar; organiser and goal facts are visible.
Stacked review rows, wrapping title and compact pending count without horizontal overflow.
Full rejection form, clear reason, required acknowledgement and full-width action.
